name: Night CTA
summary: A closing call-to-action card over a dawn skyline with a winged proof badge, big headline and pill buttons, whose background crop keeps a focal point in view on narrow screens, followed by an optional footer with wordmark, tagline, link columns with social icons and a legal line.
useWhen: A landing page needs a closing CTA card with a proof badge and two buttons
The background photo has an important subject that must stay visible when cropped on mobile
avoidWhen: Only a footer is needed; use one of the footer components in marketing/
